effect_description_eng: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add all Digimon cards with ＜Digi-Burst＞ among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon for each card added to your hand by this effect.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
